rules.measurement_method: compare the manifest generated_at value with the UTC measurement time
rules.approved_limit: generated_at must not be after measured_at
rules.consequence: block the release because future dating invalidates freshness evidence
rules.exception_path: correct and regenerate the catalog; no runtime bypass
rules.reopen_condition: an approved release policy defines a bounded clock-skew tolerance

rules.objective: make catalog freshness drift visible before release
rules.measurement_method: subtract manifest generated_at from the UTC measurement time
rules.consequence: record a review finding; do not reject the release without a separate approved hard budget
rules.exception_path: record the freshness disposition in release review
rules.reopen_condition: an approved availability or freshness objective establishes a hard maximum age

rules.objective: make canonical payload growth visible before release
rules.measurement_method: count bytes in the verified canonical catalog payload
rules.consequence: record a review finding; do not reject the release without a separate approved hard budget
rules.exception_path: record the payload-growth disposition in release review
rules.reopen_condition: an approved startup, memory, or distribution objective establishes a hard payload limit

rules.objective: make distribution artifact growth visible before release
rules.measurement_method: count bytes in the deterministic compressed catalog artifact
rules.consequence: record a review finding; do not reject the release without a separate approved hard budget
rules.exception_path: record the archive-growth disposition in release review
rules.reopen_condition: an approved download, storage, or distribution objective establishes a hard archive limit
